text:
Ben - Sales: Heads up: HelixPay wants to start a 6-week pilot next week. Kickoff Tue 9:30am. Need: scoped use cases, acceptance criteria, pricing anchor, and list of any security/infra pre-reqs.

Priya (Solutions): Proposed POC focus (lean): 1) Daily transaction summarization for reconciler dashboard, 2) Automated dispute category + next-step suggestion, 3) High-confidence AML signal tagging for manual review. Recommend ordering: summaries -> disputes -> AML.

Marco Eng: From infra POV we need target SLAs per endpoint. For summaries aim for median < 120ms and p95 < 350ms on 512 tokens. Dispute triage can be softer (p95 < 700ms). Also need expected peak QPS and average token sizes to size batching/GPUs.

Jing (Security): Send the security questionnaire responses and a sanitized dataflow diagram early. Critical items: PII handling, retention TTLs, KMS key control, where logs are stored during the pilot, and whether tokens ever cross tenant boundaries. Also need confirmation on JIT access and SSO for demo.

Ben - Sales: Client asks for SSO demo + short written answers. They gave an estimate: ~200k tokens/week ingest, 1.5k embeddings/week. Pricing expectation for hosted pilot?

Rohit (CSE): Quick hosted anchor ~ $2k/week with current small model selection and caching. If they require Dedicated bursts, add a one-time burst fee — need exact QPS to quote. Hybrid approach: hosted baseline + scheduled Dedicated windows works.

Priya (Solutions): Draft POC schedule: Week 0: legal + security signoff, infra prep. Week 1: integration + sample prompts. Weeks 2-3: tuning + evals. Week 4: UAT with product. Week 5: final polish + handoff. (Total ~6 weeks counting prep).

Marco Eng: For cost simulation I need: concurrency, avg request tokens (prompt + completion), and cache hit rate expectation. If they can provide a 200-row prompt CSV we can run quick sims.

Ben - Sales: I'll get those numbers and the prompt CSV by EOD. HelixPay ok with sanitized logs for tuning?

Jing (Security): Conditional go for kickoff if they sign our NDA addendum and provide sanitized logs + dataflow. Also need an approved subprocessors doc before any production data is shared.

Priya (Solutions): Suggested acceptance criteria to include in SOW:
```
- Summaries: median latency <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms, F1 >= 0.88 on reconciliation test set (n=250)
- Dispute triage: recall >= 85%, false positive rate <= 10% on labeled set (n=150)
- AML tagging: precision >= 82% with manual review workflow and <= 5% uplift in review load
- Integration: SDK + 2 endpoints deployed to staging, SSO demo recorded, smoke tests pass
- Security: questionnaire complete, dataflow diagram received, KMS verified in staging
```

Rohit (CSE): I'll prepare three prompt templates and an eval harness. Recommend 150-200 eval cases per flow. Threshold for pass: overall score >= 70%.

Ben - Sales: Any blockers to commit to Tue kickoff?

Marco Eng: Blockers: missing CSV + QPS numbers. Also need confirmation whether the client allows scheduled Dedicated windows for heavy batch evals.

Jing (Security): Also blocker: NDA addendum + subprocessors list. Without those security review can't sign off.

Priya (Solutions): I'll write the SOW success criteria and include a short pricing appendix (hosted vs hybrid). Will propose model variants: quantized low-latency for summaries, standard model for triage.

Ben - Sales: Thanks — I'll push the CSV and legal ask to HelixPay now and update this thread. infra-bot: create pilot workspace after we confirm kickoff. :raised_hands:

infra-bot: Pilot workspace "helixpay-pilot-1919990001" created in staging; added Priya, Marco, Rohit, Jing, Ben.

Ben - Sales: Great, I'll post client confirmations here when I have them.
